title: 第5260章 愤怒的国主第5259章 击杀烈焰尊主
lines: 幽寒国，占据足足四十九座界域，实力极为强横。
而幽寒国的大本营，则是在四十九座界域的正中央，一座漂浮的大陆之上。
在这片陆地上，有着许多宫殿阁楼，一座座恢弘大气，延绵不绝。
在那中央，一座巍峨山岳之顶，一座全由黑色晶石构建的庞大殿宇正矗立在这儿。
此时在这黑色殿宇中，一名黑袍老者正恭敬地跪伏在那儿，而在他身前并没有任何人影存在，有的就只是一尊庞大的黑色雕像。
“国主，烈焰尊主死了。”
黑袍老者语气恭敬地说着，连头也不敢抬。
黑袍老者的声音此时在这座殿宇中响起，然而短时间里却没有任何回应。
过了一会……
“烈焰……那个小子，他的师父，可是本座的生死之交，本座当年为了开创这幽寒国，率领底下诸位老弟兄征战沙场，这过程中，那些老兄弟大概死了七八成，最后没剩下几个，烈焰的师父也因此死去。”
“在临死之时，他的师父还求本座，让我替他帮忙照看他的弟子，但现在，烈焰一死，本座还有什么脸面去见那个老兄弟？”
沙哑且冰冷的声音在这座殿宇中响起。
声音虽然不大，却蕴含了无尽威严，让那跪伏在不远处的黑袍老者连大气都不敢喘一声。
半响，那沙哑低沉的声音再次响起，“你们有没有查清楚，到底是谁动的手？”
“我们正在查，但根据如今得到的一些情报，斩杀烈焰尊主的，和斩杀我幽寒国麾下六位尊主二重前期强者的，应该是同一个人。”
“此人穿着紫色衣袍，戴着紫色面具，可以断定是碎星盟强者无疑。”
“另外这个碎星盟强者行事十分古怪，他喜欢隐藏自己的灵力气息，把自己伪装成一个半步尊主。”
黑袍老者道。
“一口气击杀我幽寒国六位尊主二重前期强者强者，还杀了烈焰，不论他是谁，都绝对不能饶恕。”
低沉沙哑的声音缓缓响起，“去，务必找到他，并杀了他！”
黑袍老者恭敬地点头，随后起身离开。
黑袍老者走后，这巨大的殿宇就再次沉寂了下去。
走出殿宇后，刚才还恭敬地跪伏着，连大气都不敢喘的黑袍老者直接变了一副模样。
他的目光冰冷，身上气息无比冷冽，就连脸上也带着一些威严。
刚从殿宇走出，瞬间就有不少的强者直接围了上来。
“国主刚刚已经吩咐下来，不论那人究竟是谁，必须找到他，并杀了他！”
黑袍老者声音无比冰冷。
“遵令。”
那周围的诸多强者都是齐齐应声，他们一个个杀意冲天。
“另外，此人来自碎星盟，并且看他如今这样子很有可能是接取了碎星盟的任务。”
“这个任务极有可能是让他斩杀我幽寒国的强者，而且应该是那些有犯下重罪在身的人。”
“传令下去，让我幽寒国底下的强者这一段时间都小心点，特别是那些曾经杀戮较多的强者。”
黑袍老者又开口吩咐道。
众人纷纷点头。
很快，幽寒国的高层强者就行动起来。
content_en:
Youhan Country occupies a total of forty-nine realms and is extremely powerful.
The headquarters of Youhan Country is located on a floating continent in the center of the forty-nine realms.
On this land, there are many palaces and lofts, each one magnificent and stretching endlessly.
In the center, on the top of a majestic mountain, a huge palace built entirely of black crystal stones is standing here.
At this time, in this black palace, an old man in black robes was kneeling there respectfully. There was no figure in front of him, only a huge black statue.
"My lord, Lord Lieyan is dead."
The old man in black robe spoke respectfully, not even daring to raise his head.
The voice of the old man in black robes sounded in the palace, but there was no response for a short time.
After a while...
"Lieyyan... that boy, his master, is my life-and-death friend. In order to create this Youhan Kingdom, I led my old brothers to fight on the battlefield. In the process, about 70% to 80% of those old brothers died, and there were only a few left in the end. Lieyan's master also died because of this."
"When he was dying, his master begged me to help him take care of his disciples. But now that Lie Yan is dead, how can I have the face to meet that old brother?"
A hoarse and cold voice sounded in this palace.
Although the voice was not loud, it contained endless majesty, making the old man in black robe kneeling not far away dare not even breathe.
After a while, the hoarse and deep voice sounded again, "Have you ever found out who did it?"
"We are investigating, but according to some information we have obtained now, the person who killed the Flame Lord should be the same person as the person who killed the six powerful Lords in the early second level of our Youhan Kingdom."
"This person is wearing purple robes and a purple mask. It can be concluded that he is a strong member of the Broken Star Alliance."
"In addition, this Broken Star Alliance strongman behaves very strangely. He likes to hide his spiritual power and disguise himself as a half-step lord."
The old man in black robe said.
"In one breath, I killed the six lords of Youhan Kingdom who were strong in the early stage of the second level, and also killed Lieyan. No matter who he is, I will never forgive him."
A low and hoarse voice slowly sounded, "Go, be sure to find him and kill him!"
"Yes!"
The old man in black robe nodded respectfully, then stood up and left.
After the black-robed old man left, the huge palace fell silent again.
After walking out of the palace, the old man in black robe who had been kneeling respectfully just now and didn't even dare to breathe suddenly changed his appearance.
His eyes were cold, his aura was extremely cold, and even his face had some dignity.
As soon as he walked out of the palace, many strong men immediately surrounded him.
"The king has just given an order. No matter who that person is, he must be found and killed!"
The voice of the old man in black robe was extremely cold.
"Follow the order."
Many strong men around him responded in unison, each of them with murderous intent.
"In addition, this person is from the Broken Star Alliance, and looking at the way he is now, it is very likely that he has accepted the mission of the Broken Star Alliance."
"This mission is most likely to ask him to kill the strong men of our Youhan Kingdom, and it should be those who have committed serious crimes."
"Send the order and ask the strong men in my Youhan Kingdom to be careful during this period of time, especially those who have killed more people in the past."
The old man in black robe spoke again and gave instructions.
"Yes."
Everyone nodded.
Soon, the top leaders of Youhan Country took action.
